limitations: Seeds 20261006, 0 and 1 produced identical scripted episodes; this is one trajectory, not a multi-seed result.
The physics gate passing for the scripted demo does not make arbitrary policies safe: an RL policy that sweeps open jaws through the cecum will still invert tets, which the gate correctly reports.
Minimum appendix volume ratio drifts downward while held lifted (0.18 at 20 s, 0.10 at 40 s).
The right cutter stops 31 mm from the resection segment; at_site, jaw_on_tissue and cut remain unreached.
Friction, stiffness and pin layout remain uncalibrated engineering values; no measured force data was used.
Newton uses Newton-built tool URDFs (manufacturer FR3 joint limits); the Isaac-built pair is kept in out/isaac_urdf_backup.
